description: The operator's case list over the investigations store: one row per case aggregated from the append-only Incident Finding (2005) lifecycle records in investigations.records through the ocsf-clickhouse datasource. Latest state (severity, status, verdict, assignee) comes from the newest case record per correlation_uid; the time window controls which cases appear. The case_uid cell links to the case detail dashboard. Panels are empty until agents open cases.

panels.description: One row per case (metadata.correlation_uid): latest severity/status/verdict/assignee via argMax over the case's 2005 lifecycle records, last activity, and case record count. The case_uid cell links to the case detail dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event.metadata.correlation_uid.:String AS case_uid,
  max(nullIf(event.finding_info_list[].title.:String[1], '')) AS title,
  argMax(CASE event.severity_id.:Int64
    WHEN 6 THEN '6 Fatal' WHEN 5 THEN '5 Critical' WHEN 4 THEN '4 High' WHEN 3 THEN '3 Medium'
    WHEN 2 THEN '2 Low' WHEN 1 THEN '1 Informational' ELSE '0 Unknown' END, time) AS severity,
  argMax(CASE event.status_id.:Int64
    WHEN 1 THEN '1 New' WHEN 2 THEN '2 In Progress' WHEN 3 THEN '3 On Hold' WHEN 4 THEN '4 Resolved'
    WHEN 5 THEN '5 Closed' ELSE '0 Unknown' END, time) AS status,
  argMaxIf(CASE event.verdict_id.:Int64
    WHEN 1 THEN '1 False Positive' WHEN 2 THEN '2 True Positive' WHEN 3 THEN '3 Disregard' WHEN 4 THEN '4 Suspicious'
    WHEN 5 THEN '5 Benign' WHEN 6 THEN '6 Test' WHEN 7 THEN '7 Insufficient Data' WHEN 8 THEN '8 Security Risk'
    WHEN 9 THEN '9 Managed Externally' WHEN 10 THEN '10 Duplicate' ELSE '99 Other' END, time, event.verdict_id.:Int64 != 0) AS verdict,
  argMax(event.assignee.name.:String, time) AS assignee,
  max(time) AS last_activity,
  count() AS records
FROM investigations.records
WHERE event.class_uid.:Int64 = 2005
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY case_uid
ORDER BY last_activity DESC
